name: grid-pattern
title: Grid Pattern
description: Thin grid lines behind your content, with highlighted cells that pulse softly and an optional fade.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Width and height of one grid cell in pixels.

props.name: cells
props.description: Cells to highlight, counted from the top left starting at 0. Highlighted cells pulse one after another.

props.name: color
props.description: Token color of the lines and highlighted cells, already softened with opacity.

props.name: mask
props.description: Fade the grid toward the edges (radial) or toward the bottom (linear).

props.name: children / slot
props.description: Content shown on top of the grid.

a11y: The grid layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events.
With reduced motion, highlighted cells stay still at full strength.

ai.whenToUse: A technical, blueprint-like texture behind a hero, feature section, or signup card.
rules: Set the background color, padding, and radius with class on the component
Highlight only a few cells (2 to 6) so the pattern stays calm
Pick cellSize so the highlighted cells do not sit under the main heading

id.description: Garis grid tipis di belakang konten, dengan sel sorotan yang berdenyut lembut dan pudar opsional.

props.cellSize: Lebar dan tinggi satu sel grid dalam piksel.
props.cells: Sel yang disorot, dihitung dari kiri atas mulai 0. Sel sorotan berdenyut bergantian.
props.color: Warna token garis dan sel sorotan, sudah dilembutkan dengan opacity.
props.mask: Pudarkan grid ke arah tepi (radial) atau ke bawah (linear).
props.children / slot: Konten yang tampil di atas grid.

a11y: Lapisan grid memakai aria-hidden dan mengabaikan pointer.
Dengan reduced motion, sel sorotan diam dengan kekuatan penuh.

ai.whenToUse: Tekstur teknis mirip cetak biru di belakang hero, section fitur, atau kartu pendaftaran.
rules: Atur warna latar, padding, dan radius lewat class pada komponen
Sorot sedikit sel saja (2 sampai 6) supaya pola tetap tenang
Pilih cellSize supaya sel sorotan tidak berada di bawah judul utama
